goal: Show service health and deployed version as independently testable features
decisions: Existing feature registration interface is stable at base_revision; each feature exports its routes and card
Health returns status ok or degraded; version returns a display-only version string
constraints: No dependency changes; preserve existing routes; parent owns final feature registration

tasks.objective: Deliver a health endpoint and its card as one tested feature
interfaces: Export health route and card through the existing feature interface; GET /health returns {status: ok | degraded}
acceptance: AC1: The feature card renders healthy, degraded, pending and network-error states from its endpoint
checks: Run feature tests exercising the endpoint and rendered health card together

tasks.objective: Deliver a version endpoint and its card as one tested feature
interfaces: Export version route and card through the existing feature interface; GET /version returns {version: string}
acceptance: AC2: The feature card displays the deployed version or an unavailable state
checks: Run feature tests exercising the version endpoint and card together

tasks.objective: Register the two verified features in the application
interfaces: Preserve the existing feature registration contract and application routes
acceptance: AC3: Both features work in the real application; existing routes still work
checks: Run application integration tests and exercise healthy, degraded and unavailable service states
